privilege_credentials.description: Store separate sudo/su prompt credentials. Secrets stay in the system keychain and are only read after you click the terminal helper.

privilege_credentials.auto_submit_hint: Applies only when exactly one credential matches. SSH common credentials must also set a host pattern.
privilege_credentials.auto_requires_host_patterns: Automatic fill in SSH common requires at least one host pattern.
